title: Tech Note: 4D Database Recovery using Backups and Mirroring – Part II
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D's core mirroring architecture (principal/mirror servers, warm-standby log shipping, New log file / Integrate Mirror Log File commands) is still fundamentally how 4D mirroring and disaster recovery work today; this remains a solid, still-accurate technical reference, though 4D has continued to refine mirror setup tooling and documentation (e.g., more guided mirror configuration in the Server admin interface) since 2018.
related_updates: 4D's log-shipping-based mirroring model (New log file / Integrate Mirror Log File) is unchanged in its fundamentals

4D has added more built-in tooling/guidance for configuring and monitoring mirrors in later Server releases, but the manual recovery process described remains valid as a fallback/understanding of internals
